description: Tell Godotwright that a godot_review finding was wrong (a false alarm you verified) or right, or whether a lesson from godot_lessons helped. Pass `finding` (the line as godot_review printed it) or `lesson` (its id), not both. A finding marked wrong is hidden in later reviews on this machine, and a rule marked wrong far more often than right is reported one level lower; a lesson marked right ranks higher, wrong lower. Only use it after checking the code (godot_api, godot_check); fix real findings instead. It writes only to the local learning file (`godotwright learn reset` forgets it). An error when the line is not a finding, the lesson does not exist, or learning is off.

finding.description: the finding line, e.g. res://player.gd:12: error [api/unknown-member] ...

lesson.description: a lesson id from godot_lessons, e.g. physics/moving-platform-velocity

name: godot_feedback
title: Feedback on a review finding
